description: Implementation of the PermissionService interface handling permissions management, including CRUD operations and associations with groups, within the sales manager core business user services.

classes.name: PermissionServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing permission-related operations, including fetching, saving, deleting, and managing permissions and group associations.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to retrieve permissions by name; currently unimplemented.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Permission entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Placeholder method for saving or updating a Permission entity; currently unimplemented.

methods.name: deletePermission
methods.description: Deletes a permission entity after fetching to prevent detached entity errors and nullifies group associations.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns a list of permissions associated with provided group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Lists permissions matching specified search criteria.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes association of a permission with a specific group.
